meta.author: Abyss-Connection
meta.description: Released in 2020 by Abyss Connection, Elite Code Mechanics is a one-file demo for the Commodore 64 created for the Extended Color Mode (ECM) graphics competition. Every effect in the production is based on the C64's ECM display mode, a graphics mode with significant color restrictions that is relatively uncommon in demos. Accompanied by a soundtrack by Richard, the demo showcases a range of visual techniques built entirely within these constraints.
